STREETS OF LONG BEACH
pro

APR 10 - APR 11/#FDLB/Long Beach, California, USA

View pro Results

Formula Drift 2026 kicks off in Long Beach on April 10-11, where drivers set the season's tone with full send entries, door-to-door tandems, and nonstop tire smoke from the first run.

RD1 kicks off at #FDLB

Long Beach Street Circuit

300 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90802
